_comment: Which attributes already have something written for them, and what kind.
method 'synthesis' : a rule over the stage 1 observation fields. The label
is derived in code, so adding one costs no inference.
method 'prompt'    : a prompt of its own, run per frame.
Stage 0 routes an attribute; if it lands here, what is here is reused. Anything
absent goes to pipeline/make_rule.py (identity, facial) or make_prompt.py
(non-facial), and what those write is recorded back here.
An explicit table rather than a model judgement on purpose. Asking the model
'can this cover that attribute' adds a second place for a prompt-sensitivity
failure, and the routing prompt has already been seen to flip borderline cases
when reworded. Entries here are human-verified unless author says otherwise.

gender.note: handled by the identity adapter, K=4
gender.author: human

age.note: handled by the identity adapter, K=4, integer output
age.author: human
